sources.title: Goodman HKG10 construction report and first-service target
sources.summary: Goodman is converting an existing warehouse in Tsuen Wan into HKG10. Its September 15, 2026 announcement reports the facility under construction and targets first capacity ready for service in early 2028. Equity raised for the Hong Kong partnership will predominantly fund mechanical and electrical fit-out. September 15 is the report date; it does not establish when fit-out work began.
sources.date_semantics: September 15 is the dated operator report, which labels the named HKG10 progress photograph as current site condition and explicitly identifies the facility as under construction. It is not an image acquisition day, physical work milestone, fit-out start or opening date. Early 2028 is a first-service forecast.
